units.source_text: 她虽然决心落发出家，但此时剪刀等物都被隐藏，众侍女环守甚严。

en.t: Although she had resolved to cut off her hair and become a nun, at that moment the scissors and such things had all been hidden away, and the waiting women kept very strict watch around her.

units.source_text: 公主想道：“何必如此大惊小怪！

en.t: The princess thought, "Why make such a great fuss over this!

units.source_text: 我身又何足惜，难道会像小孩那样逃走，偷偷地把头发剪下么？

en.t: What is there in this body of mine worth clinging to? Do they think I would run away like a child and secretly cut off my hair?

units.source_text: 如此骚扰，外人听见了反会讥笑呢。”

en.t: If they make such a disturbance, outsiders who hear about it will only laugh at them."
And so she gave up her resolve to take religious vows.
